skills.name: ue5-router
skills.description: Route Unreal Engine 5.4+ development requests to the smallest relevant skill set; use at the start of any UE project, C++, Blueprint, module, build, testing, migration, or MCP task.

skills.name: ue5-project-bootstrap
skills.description: Bootstrap or normalize a UE5.4+ project workspace, including engine detection, project files, AGENTS instructions, source-control hygiene, plugins, and the first compile/test loop.

skills.name: ue5-source-navigation
skills.description: Navigate Unreal Engine 5.4+ source safely and efficiently when locating APIs, modules, ownership, call paths, version changes, or engine examples without copying restricted source.

skills.name: ue5-project-architecture
skills.description: Design a maintainable UE5.4+ project or plugin architecture, choosing gameplay classes, subsystems, modules, data assets, interfaces, ownership, dependencies, and Blueprint boundaries.

skills.name: ue5-cpp-gameplay
skills.description: Implement or review UE5.4+ gameplay C++ using Unreal ownership, lifecycle, delegates, components, subsystems, async work, containers, logging, and safe UObject-aware patterns.

skills.name: ue5-uobject-reflection
skills.description: Author or diagnose UE5.4+ UObject reflection code, UCLASS/USTRUCT/UENUM/UFUNCTION/UPROPERTY metadata, UHT failures, generated headers, GC references, serialization, and object pointers.

skills.name: ue5-modules-plugins
skills.description: Create or change UE5.4+ modules and plugins, including Build.cs, Target.cs, descriptors, API exports, Public/Private dependencies, load phases, editor/runtime separation, and circular-dependency prevention.

skills.name: ue5-blueprint-authoring
skills.description: Design, inspect, or modify UE5.4+ Blueprints and Blueprint assets through Unreal Editor, MCP, or scripting while preserving graph correctness, compile status, defaults, references, and source-control recoverability.

skills.name: ue5-cpp-blueprint-interop
skills.description: Choose and implement UE5.4+ C++ and Blueprint interoperability, including exposure metadata, events, interfaces, function libraries, data contracts, soft references, and stable designer-facing APIs.

skills.name: ue5-editor-automation
skills.description: Automate UE5.4+ Editor workflows with commandlets, Editor Utility tools, Python, subsystems, asset registry, transactions, and unattended-safe scripts without directly editing binary assets.

skills.name: ue5-testing-debugging
skills.description: Plan, implement, run, and diagnose UE5.4+ tests and failures using Automation specs, functional tests, logs, ensures/checks, crash artifacts, focused reproduction, and CI-friendly commands.

skills.name: ue5-build-cook-package
skills.description: Build, cook, stage, package, archive, or patch UE5.4+ projects with UBT, UAT, BuildCookRun, IoStore, configuration control, log triage, and reproducible artifact checks.

skills.name: ue5-performance-profiling
skills.description: Investigate and improve UE5.4+ CPU, GPU, memory, loading, shader, asset, and network performance using evidence-first profiling and changes that preserve frame and thread safety.

skills.name: ue5-version-migration
skills.description: Migrate or audit Unreal projects and plugins toward UE5.4+ while isolating UE4 and UE5.0–5.3 legacy assumptions, validating source-level API changes, build settings, reflection, assets, and behavior.

skills.name: ue5-mcp-operator
skills.description: Operate the UE5.8 native Model Context Protocol server and Toolset Registry from a Coding Agent, including setup, discovery, serial execution, Blueprint and asset workflows, recovery, and security.

skills.name: ue5-mcp-tool-authoring
skills.description: Design, implement, register, test, and secure UE5.8 MCP Toolsets or direct protocol tools using ToolsetRegistry, typed AICallable functions, async results, schemas, and explicit privilege boundaries.

skills.name: ue5-agent-skill-authoring
skills.description: Create, review, export, or update UE5.8 project-native UAgentSkill assets and portable SKILL.md instructions, with explicit user permission, concise routing metadata, and project-specific precedence.
